patterns.desc: authoritative order status enum
the store-owner new-order alert is delegated to utils/persistent-alerts.js, not sent through services/notification directly
the store-alert reminder cron runs every minute - if this interval changes, the reminder cadence in reference.md is wrong
5 reminders one minute apart, then silence - the deliberate product cadence reference.md documents; change either constant and the doc is wrong

the cutoff keeps its tick-skew slack and is NOT a round now - REMINDER_INTERVAL_MS; without it the interval equals the cron period and every other tick is skipped, turning 5-in-5-minutes into 5-in-5-to-10 silently (reference.md NOTIFICATIONS)

the sendReminders throttle is LIVE and compares a real Date - if it is commented out again, or lastReminderSent goes back to a serialised moment, all 5 reminders fire on 5 consecutive minutes (reference.md NOTIFICATIONS)

the twin assign-driver push is addressed from the RESOLVED assignment, not from the pre-update delivery snapshot - if this helper goes, the notification goes back to the previous driver (CORE invariant 11)
notifyOldDriver compares the outgoing driver against the NEWLY assigned one - comparing against deliveryDoc.driver._id again makes it always equal and the cancel push never fires (CORE invariant 11)
assignmentMetadata.previousDriver DELIBERATELY reads the stale pre-update doc - it sits beside the fix and reads identically to the bug; do not 'unify' it (CORE invariant 11)
the single-mode twin approve cascade - the reason assign-driver sends ONE push for the pair rather than one per leg (CORE invariant 11b)
FRAUD_REVIEW = 13 (doc CORE state machine)
FUTURE_ORDER_PENDING = 14
store-accept endpoint (6->1 transition)
twin linkage field on orders
server treats isFutureOrder as absent-when-false (CORE invariant 9)
update-delay freezes the pre-delay order date ONCE while orderDate accumulates (CORE invariant 10)
same preserve-once idiom on the bookDelivery row; pickupTime itself accumulates and is NOT wrapped at 24
the frozen pre-shift promise - the operand services/delivery/late-delivery.js pairs with originalPickupTime to keep the zero-ETA sentinel readable after a delay
future accept sets startPreparingAt and does NOT rewrite orderDate (ref §2)
/update-delay shifts orderDate and preserves the original (ref §5)
apps-logs.created is a real BSON Date — the opposite of orders.created, which is an offset string (CORE: where an order that never happened lives)
the device-id header, the stable installation identity abandoned-cart sessions are keyed on — NOT orders.deviceId
checkouts blocked client-side never reach the server as an order (CORE: where an order that never happened lives)
client copy of order status enum (must track server)
isRamadanIftar attached only when true (CORE invariant 9)
datetime = placed, orderDate = due; both offset strings, orderDate always set (ref §5)
the two later-day flags are mutually exclusive, from one orderTimingMode
ramadan-iftar orders can be days ahead without isFutureOrder
client copy of order status enum (must track server)

the badge-refresh path (fetchUnviewedOrdersCount, which the notification-received listener runs within a second of the server's creation push) primes once then RINGS - if this ever goes back to seedSeen the loud store.wav new-order alarm is silenced entirely, because the order is already marked alerted 30s before the poll looks (ref C3). NOT triggered by unviewed_orders_updated, which the server only emits on accept
the refresh ring is gated on isUnviewOrdersEnabled, the platform switch that owns the whole new-order ring and already gates the 30s poll (ref C3)
the ledger's prime-once-per-store-per-session entry point; seedSeen still exists but records WITHOUT ringing and must not be what the refresh path calls (ref C3)

STABILITY PIN, not a regression detector - green both before and after shoofi-partner#22, which did not introduce it. Every notification the device receives while the app runs (including the server's store.wav creation push) runs the badge refresh. This is the ONLY reason that path sees a new order ~30s before the poll, which is the whole premise of the two assertions above and of the C3 warning; drop this wiring and the doc's explanation stops being true
